purpose: correct the observation and imitation method by separating structural hierarchy from resource and organ detail

methodLearned: construct a primary axis before adding crown detail
release first-order branches only from explicit tier/node zones
release secondary branches from first-order axes rather than arbitrary world positions
place leaves in terminal/recent-twig organ zones
keep root grammar independent from crown grammar
use continuous swept surfaces along axes with explicit taper

correctionsFromR05: disable the global whole-tree metaball surface that inflated the trunk and erased hierarchy
replace it with continuous axis sweeps plus local junction collars
restrict leaf and reproductive organs to terminal organ zones
separate trunk, first-order branch, secondary branch, terminal and root-collar roles
make flowers/fruits sparse terminal sinks instead of a repeated decoration on every twig
preserve root visibility and root-collar continuity

surface.method: parallel-transport swept surface with continuous radius profile
surface.junction: local collar overlap at branch/root origins
surface.boundary: junction collars improve continuous appearance but are not yet a single watertight botanical manifold

speciesBoundary.rule: A future Species Score selects architecture, root, leaf, fruit and phyllotaxis voices.

nextWork: local branch-level water/carbon flow rather than one whole-tree budget
species-specific terminal bud and leaf geometry
continuous junction field or implicit collar microscope validation
branch shedding, damage and wound response
